description.value: For the duration you are immune to the homing rockets tech power. You and anything you wear or carry cannot be located by tech powers that reveal position, such as scan area or frequency scan, unless the caster of such a power succeeds on an Intelligence saving throw. Creatures also have disadvantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track you.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
